verdict.rationale: Svelte has no OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe confirms all candidate paths 404), and as a compiler/framework it has no REST API to describe — but it does publish a machine-readable llms.txt documentation file explicitly for LLM consumption, which serves as a partial 'equivalent' machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/JSON-schema style spec, and any first-party statement framing llms.txt as an API-spec substitute.
